page.running_head: De Mentium Finitarum Potentia, quam in CORPORA exercent in genere.

main_text.head: EXERCITATIONUM PHYSICARUM. DE Potentia Angelorum Malorum in Corpora. I.
CAPUT I.
De Mentium Finitarum Potentia, quam in CORPORA exercent in genere.
main_text.p: QUI naturam Mentis corporisque distinctè ex prima Philosophia cognovit, non inficias ibit, quòd nec de mentis essentia fit, corporicuidam, nec de corporis essentia, ut cuidam Menti jungatur, quippe utriusque essentia toto, quod ajunt, cælo differt. Quòd si igitur Mens quædam corpori conjungi debet, perinde est an magno vel parvo, subtili, crasso, fluido, molli, raro, duro; quadrato, rotundo, noto, quiescenti; imò multis corporibus

page.notes: The page number "(10.)" is printed in a decorative, partly smudged form; the title is set in spaced capitals and larger roman type. The top part of the page only is shown; the remainder is not transcribed here. The "I." under the title is a section number, given as a paragraph-level number within the title block. The first word is a woodcut initial; read as "QUI" with [?] not needed. Line-end words "corpo-ribus" are printed as "corporibus" continuing on the last line; the catchword-like word "ribus" at the right of the last line is part of the text. The opening word "Qui" is the initial letter Q with "ui" joined to "naturam" in the printed line as "UI".
